TABLE.NAME: local_lid_settings
TABLE.COMMENT: LLM connection config and prompt template per site/course scope

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = site-level default; positive integer = course-level override

FIELD.NAME: llm_endpoint
FIELD.COMMENT: LLM API endpoint URL; inherits from site level when null at course level

FIELD.NAME: llm_apikey
FIELD.COMMENT: Encrypted LLM API key; inherits from site level when null at course level

FIELD.NAME: llm_model
FIELD.COMMENT: Model string passed in API request body (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6)

FIELD.NAME: llm_maxtokens
FIELD.COMMENT: max_tokens value passed to the LLM API

FIELD.NAME: llm_timeout
FIELD.COMMENT: HTTP request timeout in seconds

FIELD.NAME: prompt_template
FIELD.COMMENT: Full session analyzer prompt template. Site level: pre-populated from prompts/default-session-analyzer.md on install. Course level: instructor override.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_locked
FIELD.COMMENT: Site-level only. 1 = teachers cannot edit prompt at course or forum level; 0 = editing permitted per local/lid:editprompt capability

FIELD.NAME: trigger_async
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = queue analysis immediately on post submission (picked up at next cron run)

FIELD.NAME: trigger_cron
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = scheduled task drains queue on configured interval

FIELD.NAME: trigger_manual
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = teachers can manually trigger analysis via UI

FIELD.NAME: cron_interval
FIELD.COMMENT: Minimum minutes between scheduled task runs (maps to task customised field). Range 1-1440.

FIELD.NAME: cron_batchsize
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum number of queue items processed per scheduled task run

FIELD.NAME: lid_default_enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Site-level only. 1 = LID analysis enabled by default for all new forums. 0 = disabled by default (teachers must opt in per forum).

FIELD.NAME: lid_force_disabled
FIELD.COMMENT: Site-level only. 1 = LID analysis force-disabled across the entire site. No teacher or course can override. Used for cost control and security lockdown.

INDEX.NAME: courseid
INDEX.COMMENT: One settings row per scope; unique on courseid enforces this

TABLE.NAME: local_lid_forum_config
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-forum LID enable/disable and optional prompt override

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: forumid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to forum.id

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Denormalised course id for efficient course-level queries

FIELD.NAME: enabled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = LID analysis active for this forum; 0 = disabled (no analysis, no dashboards)

FIELD.NAME: prompt_override
FIELD.COMMENT: Forum-level prompt override. Null = use course or site prompt. Only honoured when prompt_locked = 0.

INDEX.NAME: courseid
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup of all configured forums in a course

TABLE.NAME: local_lid_analysis
TABLE.COMMENT: LID analysis results for posts and aggregate scopes

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Analysis unit: post | forum | student_forum | course

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this analysis belongs to

FIELD.NAME: forumid
FIELD.COMMENT: Forum id; null for course-scope rows

FIELD.NAME: discussionid
FIELD.COMMENT: Forum discussion id; populated for post-scope only

FIELD.NAME: postid
FIELD.COMMENT: Forum post id; populated for post-scope only

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user id of the post author; null for forum and course scope aggregates

FIELD.NAME: analysis_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Full LID Schema v1.0 JSON. Null while status is pending or processing.

FIELD.NAME: schema_version
FIELD.COMMENT: LID schema version of the stored JSON; used by the dashboard parser for compatibility checks

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | processing | complete | error

FIELD.NAME: error_message
FIELD.COMMENT: Error detail when status = error; null on success

FIELD.NAME: llm_model
FIELD.COMMENT: Model string actually used for this analysis (snapshot at time of call)

FIELD.NAME: prompt_hash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 hash of the prompt used; allows detection of stale analyses when prompt changes

INDEX.NAME: postid
INDEX.COMMENT: Direct post-scope lookup by post id

INDEX.NAME: status
INDEX.COMMENT: Queue drain: find all pending/processing rows efficiently

TABLE.NAME: local_lid_queue
TABLE.COMMENT: Analysis job queue drained by the scheduled task

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: analysisid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to local_lid_analysis.id

FIELD.NAME: priority
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = manual (high), 2 = async, 3 = cron batch

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of LLM call attempts made for this job. Max 3 before marking as failed.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when this queue item was created

FIELD.NAME: timevisible
FIELD.COMMENT: Earliest Unix timestamp at which this item may be picked up by the scheduled task

FIELD.NAME: timeclaimed
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when the scheduled task claimed this item for processing; null if unclaimed

INDEX.NAME: priority_timevisible
INDEX.COMMENT: Task drain query: ORDER BY priority ASC, timevisible ASC with timevisible filter

INDEX.NAME: analysisid
INDEX.COMMENT: Fast lookup of queue state for a given analysis row
